# displaymotion

> Java library for Paper 26.3 plugins. Animates vanilla item, block and text displays with packets through PacketEvents. No resource pack, no real entities, no main thread work.

Use these facts when you write code with this library:

- Entry point: `DisplayMotion motion = DisplayMotion.create(plugin);` once in `onEnable`, on the main thread. It sends anonymous bStats stats, `DisplayMotion.create(plugin, false)` turns them off.
- The plugin needs `depend: [packetevents]` in plugin.yml. Do not shade PacketEvents.
- Gradle: `implementation("com.github.Jan1k1.displaymotion:displaymotion-paper:v0.2.0")` from `https://jitpack.io`, plus `compileOnly` Paper API and `com.github.retrooper:packetevents-spigot`.
- Spawn: `motion.item(location, itemStack)`, `motion.block(location, blockData)`, `motion.text(location, component)`, or `motion.model(location).block(name, blockData, pose[, parent]).item(...).text(...).spawn()`.
- Every spawn returns a `MotionDisplay`. Its methods return the same object, so chain them. They are safe from any thread.
- Crossfade: `display.crossfade(animation, ticks)`, `display.crossfade("part", animation, ticks)`, `importedModel.play(display, "clip", fadeTicks)`.
- Animate: `display.play(animation)`, `display.play(animation, onEnd)`, `display.play("part", animation)`, `display.stop()`.
- Animations: `Animations.popIn(ticks)`, `popOut(ticks)`, `spin(ticksPerTurn)`, `turn(pitch, yaw, roll, ticks)`, `bob(height, ticks)`, `slide(x, y, z, ticks, ease)`, `hold(ticks)`. Combine with `a.then(b)`, `a.with(b)`, `a.loop()`. Custom: `Animation.keyframes().at(tick, pose, ease).build()`.
- Events: `animation.event(tick, "name")` marks a tick (works through then, with, loop). `display.onEvent(event -> ...)` runs on the main thread with `event.name()`, `event.part()` (null for the whole display).
- Pose: `Pose.IDENTITY.withOffset(x, y, z).withRotation(pitch, yaw, roll).withScale(s)`. Degrees. Rotation order yaw, pitch, roll.
- Ease: `Ease.LINEAR`, `IN`, `OUT`, `IN_OUT`, `BACK_IN`, `BACK_OUT`, `ELASTIC_OUT`, `BOUNCE_IN`, `BOUNCE_OUT` (back and elastic overshoot).
- Groups: `.group(name, pose[, parent])` is an invisible pivot. Matrix parts: `.block(name, blockData, float[16] rowMajorMatrix, parent)` (also item, text, group) work like vanilla, corner pivot, whole matrix inherited.
- Effects: `motion.effects().shatter(location, blockData)`, `.tombstone(location, component)`, `.swordRain(location, itemStack)`, `.soul(location)`. Each removes itself.
- Import: `ImportedModel model = ImportedModel.load(path)` for `.bbmodel` (Blockbench) or `.bdengine` (BDEngine), then `MotionDisplay d = model.spawn(motion, location[, scale])`, `model.play(d, "animationName")`, `model.animations()`, `model.parts()`.
- Looks use Bukkit types: `display.glow(Color)`, `display.brightness(new Display.Brightness(block, sky))`, `display.billboard(Display.Billboard.CENTER)`, `display.text(Component)`, `display.background(Color)` (ARGB, behind text). Each also takes a part name first.
- Move: `display.teleport(location)` or `display.teleport(location, glideTicks)` with 0 to 59 ticks.
- Visibility: `display.hide(player)`, `display.show(player)`, `display.visibleByDefault(false)`, `display.viewRange(blocks)` (default 48).
- Clicks: `display.hitbox(width, height)` or `display.hitbox(name, width, height, x, y, z)` adds a vanilla interaction box (upright, does not follow animations, moves with teleport). `display.onClick(click -> ...)` runs on the main thread with `click.player()`, `click.hitbox()`, `click.leftClick()`, `click.rightClick()`. `motion.debug(true)` logs where a click goes.
- Riding: `display.ride(entity)` or `display.ride(entity, Follow.HEAD | BODY | NONE)` makes it a client side passenger (hats, backpacks), main thread. HEAD on a player turns and tilts around the neck, BODY follows the player body and leans when sneaking. `selfView(SelfView.SHOW | HIDE_LOOKING_DOWN | HIDE)` sets what the wearer sees (default HIDE_LOOKING_DOWN for BODY, SHOW for HEAD). The display origin is the passenger point (top of a player head). `dismount()` or `teleport` stops it.
- Follow: `display.follow(entity)` or `display.follow(entity, new Vector(right, up, forward), glideTicks)` floats after it with a lag (pets). `unfollow()` or `teleport` stops it. Main thread.
- Seats: `display.seat(name, x, y, z)` then `display.sit(player, name)` (main thread, returns false if taken) puts a player on a real invisible seat entity.
- Text: `display.type(component, ticksPerChar)` or `type("part", component, ticksPerChar[, onEnd])` types it out keeping styles; `display.count("part", from, to, ticks, n -> component)` counts with ease out. Motion thread; a manual `text(...)` stops them.
- Leaderboard: `Leaderboard board = motion.leaderboard(location).rows(10).title(component)`, then `board.update(List<Leaderboard.Entry>)` as often as needed (`Leaderboard.Entry.of(id, name, score).icon(Leaderboard.head(player))`); sorted by score, rows glide, scores count up. `board.remove()`. Main thread.
- Remove: `display.remove()`. `motion.close()` removes all, and happens by itself on plugin disable.
- Keep animations in `static final` fields. Call `play` in the same tick as spawning.
- Model rules: parent before child. Offset and rotation pass to children, a part's scale does not. Blocks pivot at their center.
- Limits: animations at most 6000 ticks, spin at least 6 ticks per turn, models at most 256 parts, text at most 32000 JSON characters.
